_note: The Control Panel's shipped defaults (lib/crissa_panel_conf.py). A fresh install watches ITS OWN services: units named crissa-*, or whose program lives in this install's folder ({root}). Change them for one install in <state home>/panel.json (same keys); this file is the product's default, not any one machine's. {root} {state} {home} {python} are expanded when read.
title: Control Panel

addons._note: The bottom section (lib/crissa_panel_addons.py). An installed add-on drops one manifest (*.json) in a folder under paths and its tiles show here; a slot with no manifest shows its placeholder, the off mark and these words, like the clock's mark for a missing camera. Add a slot or a folder for one install in <state home>/panel.json.
